signature: SUBROUTINE DLAQTR( LTRAN, LREAL, N, T, LDT, B, W, SCALE, X, WORK,

params.name: ltran
params.reference:
On entry, `LTRAN` specifies the option of conjugate transpose:

```text
= .FALSE.,    op(T+i*B) = T+i*B,
= .TRUE.,     op(T+i*B) = (T+i*B)**T.
```

params.name: lreal
params.reference:
On entry, `LREAL` specifies the input matrix structure:

```text
= .FALSE.,    the input is complex
= .TRUE.,     the input is real
```

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the order of $T+i \, B$. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: T
params.reference: On entry, T contains a matrix in Schur canonical form. If `LREAL` = .FALSE., then the first diagonal block of T $\mu$ be 1 by 1.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: b
params.reference: On entry, B contains the elements to form the matrix B as described above. If `LREAL` = .TRUE., B is not referenced.

params.name: w
params.reference: On entry, W is the diagonal element of the matrix B. If `LREAL` = .TRUE., W is not referenced.

params.name: scale
params.reference: On exit, `SCALE` is the scale factor.

params.name: x
params.reference: On entry, X contains the right hand side of the system. On exit, X is overwritten by the solution.

params.name: info
params.reference:
On exit, `INFO` is set to

0: successful exit. 1: the some diagonal 1 by 1 block has been perturbed by a small number SMIN to keep nonsingularity. 2: the some diagonal 2 by 2 block has been perturbed by a small number in DLALN2 to keep nonsingularity.

NOTE: In the interests of speed, this routine does not

check the inputs for errors.
